item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine has deployed naval drones to strike Russian warships in Libya’s Benghazi port, claiming lawful self-defence, while Russia has violated Finnish airspace with a helicopter and Polish airspace with an unmanned aerial vehicle. NATO’s chief has pledged defence against a Russian space threat after reports of a planned nuclear satellite, and MI5 has warned UK firms supplying Ukraine of sabotage risk. The UN Security Council warned that winter attacks on Ukraine’s power grid and Black Sea shipping threaten lives and global food supplies. 75,767 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
Israeli air strikes in Gaza have killed a senior Hamas security official, his wife and children, and separately eliminated Hamas’s Gaza security chief. The IDF also killed Hamas’s internal security chief and a likely replacement, while Israeli opposition members advanced a probe into the October 7 attack despite Netanyahu’s opposition. The United Nations warned of a widening risk of atrocity crimes against Palestinians and warned that the Gaza war has undone 77 years of human development. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
Israeli artillery and airstrikes continue hitting southern Lebanese towns such as Wadi Zibqin while Hezbollah persists in firing and is expanding its arsenal, including reported shipments to Yemen. Israel has reallocated $90 million from border-community recovery budgets to defense and is delaying completion of the Lebanon border wall. US sanctions on Hezbollah affiliates are viewed as having limited impact, and Iran is reported to be developing chemical weapons. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Syria: the situation
item.description:

Israeli forces shelled farmland in Quneitra province and raided southern Syria, wounding Syrian soldiers, and a drone strike in western Sweida injured four Syrian internal security personnel. Syrian security forces arrested suspects after a robbery at a Homs church, including a church guard, and also detained a fraud and sorcery suspect in Rif Dimashq. Survivors of chemical attacks gathered in The Hague to seek justice. 2,732 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Iraq: the situation
item.description:
Baghdad is deploying troops to secure Kurdistan borders after the top court authorized a military presence and a takeover of border posts and oil fields, while the prime minister is pressing for greater authority over Kurdish regions. The president is exercising ceremonial military command as the defense ministry orders nationwide troop deployment and closure of oil smuggling routes, and security forces have seized drone launchers and destroyed a militant vehicle in Al-Anbar. Hezbollah fighters have been transferred onto Popular Mobilization Forces payroll, and a KDP delegation is seeking de-escalation in Baghdad talks. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
Drone strikes have hit a United Nations building and residential areas in Khartoum, killing four people and threatening humanitarian operations, while RSF forces assaulted aid offices in Nyala and a shelter in West Kordofan, causing civilian casualties. The RSF counterintelligence chief, a commander and a group have defected to the Sudanese army in Khartoum, indicating shifting loyalties. Ethiopia offered to host inclusive Sudan peace talks and propose a national unity government, but Sudan rejected the offer and questioned Ethiopia's neutrality. The conflict produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: South Sudan: the situation
item.description:

Intercommunal clashes in Tonj East have prompted UNMISS to support deterrence efforts, while a separate attack in Greater Pibor left three dead and one wounded. MSF suspended all activities in Yei River County after staff were abducted. A rights group demanded justice for survivors of sexual violence, and the UNDP resident representative issued a message of solidarity. There were 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Ethiopian forces shelled Alamata, killing 14 civilians and prompting Amnesty International to call for a war crimes investigation in Tigray. Intelligence suggests coordination between Eritrean and Sudanese actors in drone strikes on Mekelle and Assosa. Ethiopian troops have regained control of border areas near Badme and clashes continue along the Afar-Somali border over territory, drought and resources. 2,824 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Somalia: the situation
item.description:
Federal forces have relaunched the previously failed Banooda operation, moving a major troop convoy while the defence minister reported killing 285 al-Shabaab fighters, including several commanders, in Bay, Shabelle and Hiiraan. The United States conducted airstrikes on three al-Shabaab sites, and Uganda’s president met Somalia’s president to strengthen security cooperation, with the Ugandan army chief visiting Somali troops as Uganda withdraws from Barawe. Climate shocks and insecurity are driving displacement, with over 18,000 people displaced by fighting in Southwest State as flood threats loom, and the UN warns that unrest in Ethiopia could weaken African Union security operations. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

In Mali, rebels report that more than 300 Russian soldiers have been killed as Moscow supports the military junta. A Russian envoy says Ukrainian officers are training Sahel armed groups on drones, linking external actors to the insurgency. The Sahel jihadist insurgency caused 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
M23 rebels have withdrawn from near Bunia after heavy clashes but opened a new front near the Uganda border and are advancing on Uvira city. WHO evacuated its Ebola response team from an Ituri hospital after they were trapped by fighting, and the Ebola death rate is now near 50%. A Congolese military aircraft went missing after rebels claimed to have shot it down, leading to the capture of a South African mercenary. Kenya and the DRC have agreed to restore diplomatic ties following recent tensions. The conflict has displaced 8.2 million people, according to DNE Africa, and there were 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
